verdict.rationale: Workable is an ATS, so a unified candidate record is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never documents a single candidate profile that holds resume, email threads, interview feedback, activity history and consent status. The only nearby items are separate API fragments: candidate ratings, the latest offer, and a generic events collection. These are adjacent building blocks, not the unified profile the story describes.

support.subject: As a recruiter, every candidate has one unified profile — resume, email threads, interview feedback, activity history, and consent status in a single record
